summary: Found one documentation contradiction: the docs claim Starlette only requires `anyio`, but the project metadata declares `typing_extensions` as a required dependency on Python versions below 3.13.

findings.title: Documentation says Starlette only requires `anyio`, but `typing_extensions` is a required dependency on Python < 3.13
findings.evidence: README.md and docs/index.md state: "Starlette only requires `anyio`". However, pyproject.toml declares `dependencies = ["anyio>=4.0.0,<5", "typing_extensions>=4.10.0; python_version < '3.13'"]`, making `typing_extensions` a required dependency on Python versions below 3.13.
findings.suggested_fix: Update the dependency documentation to state that Starlette requires `anyio`, and also requires `typing_extensions` on Python versions below 3.13.
findings.verification_notes: Confirmed: README/docs say "only requires anyio"; pyproject.toml also requires typing_extensions on Python < 3.13. Kept as low severity (conditional dependency).
